title: Preservation of an existing circuit value
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $G$ be a finite list of Boolean gates, let $x$ assign a Boolean value to each of the first $n$ inputs, and let $u,o$ be gate-value indices satisfying $u<n+|G|$ and $o<n+|G|$. Appending the three gates that negate the value at $u$, take its disjunction with the value at index $n+|G|$, and then conjoin the value at $o$ with the value at index $n+|G|+1$ leaves the value at output index $n+|G|+2$ equal to the original value at index $o$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite list of Boolean gates $G$
An assignment of Boolean values to the $n$ inputs
